correctness.rationale: Exact unit-edge support test r cos(b-theta) <= cos b proves complete hull vertex structure, including endpoint equality. The cyclic shoelace formula and chord lengths prove both volume formulas. The symbolic identity for the squared derivative signs factorizes as 2(cos theta - cos(2b-theta))(r T-c)(T-r c), strictly positive in the active interval. At the optimum, direct radical expansions give first-order area and second-order perimeter threshold gains. Actual scipy convex-hull construction tested 10,619 parameter combinations with zero discrepancies above 2e-7; finite tests only corroborate the complete analytic proof.

value.rationale: Two natural Euclidean intrinsic volumes and full combinatorial hull structure are classified simultaneously for every n and all continuous scale/rotation parameters. This resolves a geometrically motivated containment-to-exposure transition, proves one sharp optimizer for two different functionals, and distinguishes first-order area onset from second-order perimeter onset. Those exact exponents exhibit a structural boundary phenomenon and make the result more than a single textbook chord calculation.
